{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows
display(sales_df.head())

# Display basic info about the data
display(sales_df.info())

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()
display(missing_values)

# Check for duplicates
duplicate_rows = sales_df.duplicated().sum()
display(duplicate_rows)

# Check unique values in key columns
print("Unique values in 'customer_type':")
display(sales_df['customer_type'].unique())

print("Unique values in 'converted':")
display(sales_df['converted'].unique())"}
